summary: R152 residual: TASK-3 factory_physical_attempt_authority_closed / director_no_materialized_changes / tool_lifecycle_failed was caused by bench event-wait treating a single runtime.v2 keepalive ping timeout as fatal and immediately cancelling a healthy multi-task Director stage.

mechanism: wait_run_until_terminal used websockets.connect(ping_interval=30) with default short ping_timeout
On WebSocketException, returned runtime_v2_connection_failed immediately without reconnect
run_factory_chain cancelled backend run whenever event_wait_error present
Cancel closed FactoryRoleEvidenceAuthority / physical attempt grants
TASK-3 reserve/start failed factory_physical_attempt_authority_closed before tools

fix.principle: Observation failure must not kill healthy execution before wall-clock deadline (Codex/agent CLI reconnect pattern)
changes: Reconnect runtime.v2 WS until wall-clock deadline with exponential backoff
Raise ping_timeout to 120s and ping_interval to 20s
Only surface runtime_v2_connection_failed / timeout after deadline
Cancel reason distinguishes connection-failed vs pure timeout
